description: This file defines a React component for a toast notification system, including context, provider, and hook for managing toast messages with different tones (success, error, info). It handles rendering, auto-dismissal, and external access to toast actions.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID based on current timestamp and a random string.
